title: Sakura
pickField: Pick the field card to take (two of them match).
turnYours: Your turn — play a hand card to take a field card of the same month.

tutorial.field: These are the field cards. Play a hand card to take a field card of the same month; when two match you choose which one to take.
tutorial.hand: This is your hand. Playing a card takes a matching field card, then one stock card is flipped and resolved the same way.
tutorial.info: Sakura (Higo-bana) is a Kumamoto hanafuda game played with the 48-card deck. Unlike Koi-Koi it is not scored by yaku: you add up the cards you took (Bright 20, Animal 10, Ribbon 5, Chaff 1). Taking both the Curtain and the Moon scores a 30-point Sakura-zake bonus, and all five Brights score 100.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.

frontendHint.sakuraRoundIsOver: the round is over — move on to the next one
frontendHint.sakuraTakeTheMatch: a field card of the same month is available; taking always scores
frontendHint.sakuraDiscardCheapest: nothing matches, so give up the cheapest card
